vs

full_judgment: 15. The Labour Court has come to finding that since the respondent No. 2 is still in service the application under section 34 of IRO 1999 is maintainable. The learned Labour Court has also decided the second and third issues inasmuch as that there are causes of action and the application is not liable to be dismissed for lack of cause of action. The Labour Court has come to finding that the case is not barred under the law of limitation. The Labour Court has also decided the issue Nos. 4 and 5 in favour of the respondent No. 2 and accordingly, directed the petitioner to withdraw the impugned order dated 31-8-95 by which the respondent No. 2 was punished.
